## Wave 2 Summary

Wave 2 carries the three empirical bridges that survived dedup against inv-2…inv-12 from the sagan-empiricist survey — each pushing the framework toward a domain where it can make a falsifiable prediction ORTHOGONAL to the n_s/A_s/w_0 CMB-cosmology axis that currently carries all of the framework's empirical risk. It is a **mixed-type** wave: **2 compute gates + 1 review gate**. **INV13-W2-1** (compute, nazarewicz-nuclear-structure-theorist) translates seed UB2 — runs the van Suijlekom finite-density spectral-action extension `D_μ = D + μ Q` at the dense-QCD regime (high baryon chemical potential μ), where the SU(3) fiber IS color and the U(1)_7-breaking BCS condensate IS structurally a CFL/2SC diquark condensate, computing Δ_CFL(μ) + the EoS stiffness against the 2 M_⊙-pulsar / NICER bound; this is a NEW regime for existing machinery (finite-μ has never been run — only the cosmological fold; the finite-density formalism for self-consistent μ was tagged "CLOSED — no formalism developed, deprioritized" at S38, confirming genuinely-untraveled territory). **INV13-W2-2** (compute, cosmic-web-theorist) translates seed UB3 — turns the static σ8 = 0.799 + the −4.058% f·σ8 product-suppression seed (Row #71, z=0.51) into a redshift-dependent growth-suppression curve f·σ8(z) at the clustering scale (k ~ 0.1–0.3 h/Mpc) that DESI/Euclid can bind directly, testing whether the GGE-relic acoustic-interference growth-suppression lands the framework's S8 BETWEEN Planck (≈0.83) and weak-lensing (KiDS/DES ≈0.76), and whether a growth-suppression success at the clustering scale while n_s fails at the CMB pivot LOCALIZES a possible n_s failure to the K_pivot mapping. **INV13-W2-3** (review, sagan-empiricist, its own domain) translates seed R5 — a formal post-S66 Bayesian re-anchoring ANALYSIS replacing the ordinal-leverage EVOI proxies with elicited P(pass) Bayes factors per observable, correcting for the look-elsewhere effect on the multi-anchor n_s/α_s comparisons, and adjudicating the structural-up / observational-down recomposition finding (structural evidence strengthened: 10 blind-cross-axis-verified STAGE-3 promotions S90/S100a/S105/S106/S108; observational evidence weakened: n_s + w_a both drifting away). The two compute gates each carry a **[SIGN]** trigger (W2-1: the μ-dependence of Δ_CFL; W2-2: the growth-suppression direction — must suppress, f·σ8 < ΛCDM). The review gate closes by **artifact-existence-with-content** (its deliverable md) and emits **NO verdict line**.

The three gates are **mutually independent** — no intra-wave forward pins; each can dispatch in parallel the moment Wave 2 opens. Their upstream prerequisites (all already-landed canonical results, available at dispatch — no in-session prior-wave dependency) are:

- **INV13-W2-1** consumes: van Suijlekom finite-density formalism `D_μ = D + μ Q` (Paper 30 / Dong-Khalkhali-van Suijlekom 2022, BdG spectral-action paper PROVEN, `session-34-master-synthesis.md`); the BCS instability theorem **B1** (RG-BCS-35, PROVEN: any g>0 → strong coupling on the van Hove fold, 3 independent methods, A_2-catastrophe-stable Van Hove singularity, `atlas-04-assumptions.md`); the Kosmann-connection pairing interaction **B2** (atlas-04 B2, CONDITIONAL — K_a is the natural metric-compatible anti-Hermitian connection on the spinor bundle); the SU(3)-fiber-as-color identification; canonical `M_KK`, `tau_fold`. External anchors (methodological cross-check, NOT substrate canonical): NICER mass-radius (R ≈ 11–13 km at M ≈ 1.4–2.1 M_⊙, PSR J0030+0451 / J0740+6620); the 2 M_⊙-pulsar bound. **All available at dispatch.**

- **INV13-W2-3** (review) reads: `sessions/evoi-framework.md` (currency S109, Tier-1/Tier-2 tables); `sessions/framework/Atlas/atlas-06-*` (directional-only post-S66); `sessions/framework/Atlas/atlas-08-open-questions.md` Q44 (the standing Sagan re-anchoring carry-forward, frozen since S66 W2-A); `sessions/framework/registry/falsifier-master-inventory.md` (Rows #1-#12 headline + #85 multi-anchor n_s); the n_s σ-ladder (1.40σ→~5σ), w_a 3.43σ, the A_s wall, m_H +38.5σ, the CC tracking anchors; sagan's session-lessons memory. **All available at dispatch.**

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (6) audit_discriminators — which inputs feed audit_sha256 vs content_sha256
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain — MANDATORY for the [SIGN] claim on dΔ_CFL/dμ
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "In the dense-QCD regime the color-superconducting gap Δ_CFL INCREASES with chemical
            potential μ (dΔ_CFL/dμ > 0), the standard color-superconductivity direction."

    Substitution chain:
      Step 1: D_μ = D + μ Q                                 [van Suijlekom grand-canonical, Paper 30 / DKvS-2022 §8.2]
              — Q is the U(1) charge generator; μ shifts the Dirac operator's spectral center.
      Step 2: Density of states at the pairing surface:
              g(μ) = g_VanHove · (DOS enhancement from the A_2-catastrophe Van-Hove cusp)   [B1, RG-BCS-35 PROVEN]
              — raising μ moves the chemical-potential surface; in the SU(3)-fiber band structure
                the Van-Hove singularity gives g(ω) ~ 1/sqrt(ω - ω_min) (zero-critical-coupling),
                so g(μ) is monotone-increasing as μ approaches the cusp from the dense side.
      Step 3: BCS/CFL gap equation at zero critical coupling (1D Cooper theorem, B1):
              Δ_CFL(μ) = 2 ω_D exp(-1 / (g(μ) · V_Kosmann))                                 [B2 Kosmann pairing interaction V]
              — V_Kosmann (the Kosmann-connection pairing kernel) is μ-independent at leading
                order (it is the spinor-bundle connection, set by geometry, not density).
      Step 4: Substitute and differentiate:
              d ln Δ_CFL / dμ = + [1 / (g(μ)² · V_Kosmann)] · (dg/dμ)
              — dg/dμ > 0 (Step 2, monotone DOS toward the cusp); V_Kosmann > 0 (attractive
                pairing, B2); g(μ)² > 0. Therefore every factor on the RHS is positive.
      Step 5: d ln Δ_CFL / dμ > 0  ⇒  dΔ_CFL/dμ > 0   (since Δ_CFL > 0).                     [direction read-off]
      Conclusion: Δ_CFL is a strictly increasing function of μ in the dense regime. A computed
                  dΔ_CFL/dμ <= 0 anywhere in the scan window is a SIGN FAIL — it would mean the
                  substrate's diquark pairing weakens with density, contradicting both the B1
                  Van-Hove structure and observed color-superconductivity phenomenology.
      Caveat (regime): if the μ-scan exits the regime where the Van-Hove cusp dominates the DOS
                  (μ pushed past the band edge), Step 2 monotonicity can break; the regime_verdict
                  axis tracks the fraction of the scan window inside the Van-Hove-dominated regime.

# (8) input_files — every file the producing_script reads, with SHA pin

PASS_meaning: "The GGE-relic growth-suppression curve lands S8_FW ∈ [0.76, 0.83] (between Planck and weak-lensing) with a strictly-negative suppression (sign-PASS) AND a DESI/Euclid-bindable z-shape (≥1 redshift bin where the suppression exceeds the survey σ). FAIL_meaning: "Either S8_FW falls outside [0.76, 0.83] (the prediction does NOT sit between Planck and lensing — it either over-suppresses below lensing or fails to suppress enough to clear Planck), OR δ(f·σ8)(z) >= 0 somewhere in z ∈ [0, 1.5] (growth ENHANCEMENT — sign FAIL, contradicting the −4.058% Row #71 seed). Closes the corridor: the GGE-interference growth-suppression does NOT resolve the S8 tension; the static σ8 = 0.799 coincidence does not extend to a viable z-dependent growth prediction."
INFO_meaning: "S8_FW is in-band AND the suppression is sign-PASS (negative everywhere), but the z-dependence is too flat to bind at DESI/Euclid (no redshift bin's suppression exceeds the survey σ). The prediction is observationally VIABLE (right magnitude, right direction) but not yet DISCRIMINATING at near-term surveys — routes to a z-shape-refinement carry-forward (sharpen the per-z suppression amplitude, or extend the k-band)."

      - "P(pass)"                                                              # elicited per-observable pass probabilities
      - "look-elsewhere"                                                       # the trial-factor / Gross-Vitells correction
      - "recomposition"                                                       # the structural-up / observational-down finding

  # §"Investigation-Track Canonical Path": only compute/solo gates emit verdict lines).

# ---- Verdict rubric (review closure semantic) ----
PASS_meaning: "LANDED — the synthesis md exists with all must_contain markers: a per-observable P(pass)/Bayes-factor table, the look-elsewhere correction, the prediction/fit/accommodation triage, and the recomposition finding. The post-S66 Bayesian re-anchoring analysis is on disk as the INPUT to the session-track EVOI re-anchor + mack co-dispatch (which promote at /rclab-investigate close). NOT a numerical PASS — review closure is artifact-existence."
FAIL_meaning: "NOT-LANDED — the synthesis md is absent OR a must_contain marker is missing (a stub: e.g., the BF table or the look-elsewhere correction or the recomposition finding is not present). Re-dispatch a write-only follow-up; the re-anchoring analysis is the seed-R5 deliverable and the standing Q44 carry-forward — it must be written in full."
INFO_meaning: "N/A for a review gate — the closure is binary artifact-existence (LANDED / NOT-LANDED). Any intermediate-evidence judgment lives INSIDE the synthesis (e.g., an observable whose BF is genuinely indeterminate is reported as such in the table), not as a gate-level INFO token."

# ---- Effort + framing ----
effort:
  files_created:
    - "sessions/investigation/investigation-13/investigation-13-bayesian-reanchor-synthesis.md"
  estimated_time: "~1.5 review (independent reading of the EVOI/atlas/falsifier registers + Sagan's own calibration memory + the per-observable BF elicitation + write-up)"

substrate_framing: |
  NON-PHONONIC — methodology / evidence-assessment contribution. This gate does not compute a
  substrate observable; it is the empirical-conscience adjudication of the framework's evidential
  state. The methodology contribution: it replaces the EVOI table's ORDINAL leverage proxies
  (admitted in evoi-prioritization.md to be "ordinal leverage proxies, not calibrated
  probabilities") with ELICITED P(pass) Bayes factors per observable, applies the look-elsewhere
  correction the framework's own falsifier inventory (Row #85) gestures at, and formalizes the
  recomposition that forty unadjudicated sessions have produced. It honors the substrate-first
  framing at the meta-level: every BF weights a SUBSTRATE-IS prediction (n_s from gauge-invariant
  spectral geometry, m_H from the KK threshold, the neutrino cluster from the D_K block ordering)
  against its observational anchor — and the analysis explicitly credits the zero-parameter
  geometric passes at full BF (no postdiction discount), exactly as the Sagan methodology
  requires. The finding — that the framework's footing has shifted toward publishable mathematics
  + lab/JUNO falsifiers and away from CMB-cosmology fit — is itself a substrate-relevant verdict:
  it says WHERE the substrate's predictions are strong (dimensionless, anchor-free, zero-parameter)
  and where they are exposed (absolute CMB scales the substrate cannot fix without an external
  M_KK).

## Wave 2 → (terminal) Decision Point

Wave 2 is the **terminal wave** of Investigation 13 (the 2-wave partition closes here; Wave 1 — collider bispectrum / a₄ QNM / w₀ truncation — is independent and owned by gen-physicist). No Wave 3 consumes these outputs. The branch table below routes each gate's outcome to its `/rclab-investigate --investigation 13` close action (session-promotion of the investigation's results, NOT an in-investigation downstream gate):

| Gate | Outcome | Close-action (at /rclab-investigate --investigation 13) |
|:-----|:--------|:---------------------------------------------------------|
| INV13-W2-1 | **PASS** (M_max ∈ [2.0,2.6] M_sun, sign-PASS) | Promote the finite-μ CFL-EoS result as a carry-forward into a session-mode plan (re-compute under a `session-{N}` gate to enter the permanent-results ledger); flag as the framework's FIRST compact-object-sector anchor (seed UB1/UB2 bridge) and a NICER-orthogonal test of seed A3. Re-open the S38-CLOSED "finite-density spectral action (P2b)" / S25 Goal-7 self-consistent-μ_eff open item — THIS gate's machinery is the formalism that was missing. |
| INV13-W2-1 | **FAIL** (too soft OR sign FAIL) | Record the corridor closure (the cosmological-fold BCS-on-SU(3) does NOT extend to dense matter); route to seed-A3 evidence (the SA-as-dynamical-functional question gains a NICER-side negative). No session-promotion of a prediction; promotion of the closure as a constraint-map entry. |
| INV13-W2-1 | **INFO** (qual. stiff, un-banded OR regime MARGINAL) | Carry-forward a finite-μ-refinement compute (self-consistent μ_eff; extend the Van-Hove-regime window) into the next session plan. |
| INV13-W2-2 | **PASS** (S8 in-band, sign-PASS, z-bindable) | Promote the f·σ8(z) curve as the LSS near-term flagship leg (seed UB3; the GW flagship retired S96); route to mack (sole writer of falsifier-master-inventory) for a new/updated Row landing on the S8-tension-resolution prediction with explicit DESI/Euclid σ-distances. Activate the K_pivot-localization diagnostic (G1↔G3 bridge). |
| INV13-W2-2 | **FAIL** (S8 out-of-band OR sign FAIL) | Record the corridor closure (the GGE growth-suppression does not resolve S8); the static σ8 = 0.799 coincidence does not extend to a z-dependent prediction. Constraint-map entry, no flagship promotion. |
| INV13-W2-2 | **INFO** (in-band + sign-PASS, un-bindable shape) | Carry-forward a z-shape-refinement compute (sharpen per-z amplitude / extend k-band) into the next session plan. |
| INV13-W2-3 | **LANDED** (synthesis md exists, all markers) | The re-anchoring analysis becomes the INPUT to the session-track EVOI-register re-anchor (rewrite `sessions/evoi-framework.md` Tier tables with the elicited P(pass) BFs) + the mack + Sagan co-dispatch on the observational-surface rows. Both are session-track actions; /rclab-investigate lifts them into the housekeeping ledger as turnkey promotions (target + recommended edit). Closes Q44. |
| INV13-W2-3 | **NOT-LANDED** (stub / missing marker) | Re-dispatch a write-only sagan-empiricist follow-up to complete the synthesis; the seed-R5 deliverable + standing Q44 carry-forward must be written in full before close. |
